verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unleash has backend/server SDKs with backend tokens, and Unleash Edge acts as a caching read-replica layer that processes targeting data within the Edge node. None of the items documents that the server SDKs themselves cache the ruleset and evaluate flags in-process with no network call per check, nor any microsecond-latency decisions. Edge is an adjacent proxy/caching capability, not in-SDK local evaluation, so it earns no credit here.
